response.answer: I take ownership of murky vendor incidents by establishing a clear evidence base before communicating conclusions. I separate verified contract facts from vendor claims, provide prompt updates on undisputed facts, and hold attribution until the supporting export is available. I also investigate and correct record issues at their source. During the November vendor outage, this approach produced a statement that passed legal review unchanged; where a vendor explicitly admits fault, I communicate that promptly.
